questions.question_en: Why did you choose to be an air traffic controller?
questions.question_cn: 为什么你选择了空中交通管制这个职业？

questions.question_en: What are the important qualities that an air traffic controller should have?
questions.question_cn: 一名管制员应有的重要品质是什么？
questions.answer: 见OPI话题分析画图：日常问题-工作经历部分（参见OPI 1-2自我介绍部分）
questions.note: 原文标注见OPI话题分析画图

questions.question_en: Do you think on-the-job training is important for controllers? Why?
questions.question_cn: 你认为工作培训对于管制员来说是重要的吗？为什么？
questions.answer: Yes, I think so, because first, it will help us to improve our efficiency and reduce human error. Then, we can learn about new equipment and procedures during training.

questions.question_en: Have you ever flown with a flight crew to experience the whole flight? Do you think it is necessary for controllers?
questions.question_cn: 你曾经有过和机组体验整个飞行过程的经历吗？你认为对于管制员来说它是必要的吗？
questions.answer: Yes. We had the airline practice, controllers can follow the flight crew to experience a whole flight. I think it's very necessary, because we can know more about the crew's work and their flight procedures. Also, it will help us to improve our service.

questions.question_en: Do you often exchange ideas with pilots on some concerns about flight and air traffic control?
questions.question_cn: 你经常就一些飞行员和管制员关心的事交换意见吗？
questions.answer: Sure. I have some pilot friends, we talk about our work very often. They will share their suggestions and complaints. I will explain our working procedures and regulations. It's good for my job.

questions.question_en: How should controllers cooperate with pilots in maintaining an orderly flow of traffic?
questions.question_cn: 管制员和飞行员如何配合才能保持有序的交通流量？
questions.answer: First, we should communicate well, follow regulations and SOP. Then, we should share info about weather, traffic and emergency situation. Also, I should respect the captain's decision and provide necessary help.

questions.question_en: If disputes occur between you and the pilots, what should you do to ensure flight safety?
questions.question_cn: 如果你与飞行员间产生争论，你将做什么来确保安全？
questions.answer: First, I should explain the reason of my decision, remind pilot to check operation minima. Then, I will ask for his intention, provide help. Also, I should never quarrel with pilots on the frequency.

questions.question_en: What should you do when the flight crew doesn't follow your instruction in flight?
questions.question_cn: 当飞行员没有按你指令飞行时，你将如何做？
questions.answer: First, I will say again the instruction, and confirm the reason of his decision. Then, I will warn him about the danger of this situation, and confirm his intentions. If he insists to not follow my instructions, I should report to supervisor and related ATC units. Also, I should instruct other A/C to avoid him. Sometimes, not following ATC instructions can mean hijack situation. So I should check for it.

questions.question_en: If you make mistakes in your instruction and the flight crew point it out, do you think you lose face and how do you correct it to ensure flight safety?
questions.question_cn: 如果你的指令出现错误，机组指出了错误，你觉得丢脸了，如何改正它以确保安全？
questions.answer: OK, first of all, I think it's a good thing that the pilot can point out my mistake. I will admit the mistake and correct instructions immediately. Normally, I will say 'correction' and the correct content.

questions.question_en: Have you ever encountered the situation of a missed approach?
questions.question_cn: 你曾经遇到过复飞情况吗？

questions.question_en: What are the possible reasons for a missed approach?
questions.question_cn: 对于复飞，什么是最可能的原因？

questions.question_en: When the flight crew makes a decision to land instead of following controllers' advice of going around, what should controllers do?
questions.question_cn: 当机组决定落地而不是听从管制员复飞的建议时，管制员应该怎么做？
questions.answer: First, I should inform the pilot about ground situation and weather. Then, I should make sure the RWY is clear. Also, I should remind pilot to check the RWY and the landing minima.

questions.question_en: Under what situations is emergency descent necessary?
questions.question_cn: 在什么情况下，必需紧急下降？
questions.answer: If there is fire, smoke or decompression problem on board, ED is necessary.

questions.question_en: When the flight crew reports they are making emergency descent, what help can ATC provide to the crew?
questions.question_cn: 当机组报告他们要紧急下降时，管制员准备给机组提供什么帮助？
questions.answer: First, I can instruct other A/C to avoid. Then, I should inform related ATC units about this situation, and request more airspace. Also, I should monitor the A/C, ask for the pilot's intention.

questions.question_en: When emergency descent occurs, how do you coordinate with controllers in other control units?
questions.question_cn: 当紧急下降发生时，你是如何协调其他管制单位的？
questions.answer: First, I will inform related ATC units about the situation and destination altitude. Then, I can request more airspace and ground services. Also, I should work with other ATC unit to avoid conflict.
